title: Does neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio add lung-function prediction beyond its components? A cross-cycle test
abstract: Adding sex-specific neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio splines to flexible component-count and standard-measure models changed NHANES2011-2012 FEV1/FVC weighted MSE by +0.000000721; joint bootstrap95% [-0.000014153,+0.000097059], after fitting NHANES2007-2008. The registered incremental-prediction criterion was not met; this is not an equivalence test. This tests a known marker representation, not a novel biological measurement. Independent recruitment cycles share a platform; the reused target is not untouched confirmation. No clinical utility or causal mechanism is established.
